records.context_en: Check engine light and/or DIM message with camshaft-related context
diagnostic_steps: For vehicles within the bulletin, clear DTCs and place transmission in PARK
Hold engine at 1500-2200 RPM for 10 s, return to idle and wait 3 s; repeat 10 times as prescribed
Check recurrence; if absent road test and repeat relevant check
Only if DTC returns, follow VIDA for intake camshaft and timing belt; use hand tools only as required by TJ

records.context_en: Propulsion System Service Required may be a false report; check turtle warning and drivability
diagnostic_steps: Check if drivable and whether turtle warning is shown
For structure weeks 202147-202446 follow approved ECM software upgrade v3.4.4 per TJ31543
If no turtle warning and vehicle drivable, follow TJ: do not replace parts based on code alone
For turtle warning, erase code, allow Abandoned mode for at least 20 min, idle 3 min, then reread VIDA; escalate persistent code
